_about: 0.31a2's lower screen shake (the owner, 2026-11-01): where 0.31a2 reduced it, these guns take its recoil/min_shake_recoil, max_shake_recoil and shake_time_scale, the values of 0.31a2's own configs (gameplay/items/weapons/assault/{m4a1,hk416,msbs_carbine}, smg/uzi*, sniper/{vss,vsk_94}*.options). M4A1, HK416, MSBS carbine and the three UZIs (wpn_uzi, the golden wpn_uzi_premium and wpn_uzi_premium_2): 0.8/1 -> 0.2/0.4, the time scale 8 as live. VSS and VSK-94 (and their golden wpn_vss_premium, wpn_vsk_94_premium): 0.5/0.7 -> 0.2/0.3 and shake_time_scale 3 -> 8 (0.31a2 changed it with the amplitudes). A shot adds a uniform draw between min and max to the weapon's shake z (0..1, weapon_recoil_calculator::on_shot 0x331C50); z weights the camerashake_v2 clip, an additive animation of the shooter's arms and held item, played at shake_time_scale in the fire state (get_camera_shake_lexeme 0x2E13A0, weight 0x2E39B0). It does not move the view or the shot (the view pitch takes only the kick y), but z is the weapon's serialized recoil state (0x331FF0), so the change is a simulation change. Types: min_shake_recoil and the 0.5/0.7 floats stay floats, shake_time_scale stays an int; max_shake_recoil is an int 1 in the six 0.8/1 guns and becomes the float 0.4 (as 0.31a2 has it; the loader 0x331840 reads an int or a float).
